title: Senior Creative Strategist
description:
About Sidekick

At Sidekick , we help people recover faster from injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products have been featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine . With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.
The role
A lot of performance creative work goes into creating demand that wasn't there. That's not the problem here. Our customer already wants what we sell. Their heel hurts every morning when they get out of bed, or their ankle rolls on uneven ground and they've stopped trusting it.
What they don't believe is that this is the thing that finally works. They've already bought the insoles, done the stretches, and gone to physio twice. So you have to teach before you can sell, and you have to earn trust from someone who has been let down already. It's a harder brief than most, and a more interesting one.
You'll write our paid social advertising and own angle development and testing, reporting to our Creative Director. Expect to ship around 15 briefs a week, a mix of net-new concepts and iterations on ads that are already working. Your week is writing, research, and feedback to editors.
You don't need a physiotherapy background, but you do need to pick up a clinical concept quickly enough to explain it clearly and honestly in fifteen seconds of camera time.
What you'll do

•
Find new winning angles. Better creative is what lets us spend more, so we need a steady supply of ads that keep working as budgets grow.

•
Open new audiences. Runners, older adults worried about falling, people on their feet all day. Each group buys for a different reason, and every one we crack opens up new demand.

•
Get more life out of winners. Read the data weekly, iterate what's working, retire what's finished.

•
Write the scripts. Short and long-form video, hooks that stop the scroll, dialogue that sounds like a real person. This is most of your week.

•
Direct the edit. Brief and manage editors and creators so the idea survives production.

•
Extend what wins. Take proven angles into landing pages and email.

Requirements
What we're looking for

• 4+ years writing paid social ads that were judged on sales (not brand awareness, engagement etc.)

• Your ads have been responsible for over $100K+/month in ad spend (across all your ads, for a single brand). We'll ask you to walk us through it.

• Proof you can iterate on a winner. Plenty of people can write one good ad; we want someone who gets eight more out of it.

• You've opened a new audience before, and you can name the angle that got you in

• Excellent writing for spoken word, which is a different skill from writing for the page

• Strong direct response fundamentals: offer, mechanism, objection handling, proof

• Experience briefing editors or creators

• Health, fitness or medical device categories are a plus

What we care about
We want people who are ambitious and hold themselves to a high standard. They don't need to be managed closely, and want to be the best at their craft. The volume is real and the feedback is direct. In exchange you'll see more results in a year than most people see in three. If you're looking for something comfortable, this won't be the right fit for you.
Benefits

• Compensation: Top of the market for this role. We’ll share compensation details on the first call.

• Fast-growing company whose mission is to solve chronic pain and injuries

• You’ll see the direct impact of your work on business results

• You’ll be held to a high bar, which means you’ll get better fast

• Fun, approachable yet ambitious colleagues

• Comprehensive health benefits

• Work from home

title: Search Engineer, AI Infrastructure (SF)
description:
Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.
About the Company
Our client builds the data layer that AI agents run on. One API call turns any URL into clean, structured, LLM-ready data. It is already the default way a huge number of developers pull web data into their AI systems.
The numbers back it up: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled that in year two, and 125,000+ GitHub stars. They just closed a $75M Series B. The company is small, moving fast, and hiring people who want to build the next chapter with them.
The Mission
They believe developers and AI agents should not have to fight the web to get useful data out of it. Every hour spent maintaining a scraper, dealing with stale pages, or working around brittle retrieval systems is an hour taken away from the actual product.
Their job is to make that problem disappear: give AI systems reliable access to the live web, then make the results clean, current, structured, and useful enough to power real products.
The Opportunity
As a Search Engineer , you will own the systems that turn the open web into a high-quality search index.
You will work directly with the Head of Search and a small team to build and improve the crawling, indexing, retrieval, ranking, and serving infrastructure behind a fast-growing search product. This is an end-to-end role: you will improve relevance while solving the real constraints of search at scale - freshness, deduplication, latency, reliability, and cost per query.
The key requirement is direct production ownership of ranking and relevance. You should be able to point to a search-quality change you personally shipped and the metric it improved.
What You’ll Do

• Own ranking quality and relevance for LLM-driven search and retrieval

• Build and operate the crawling, indexing, retrieval, and search-serving systems behind the product.

• Improve search quality using lexical, semantic, hybrid, and reranking approaches

• Reduce latency and cost per query as query volume and corpus size grow, without compromising relevance, correctness, or reliability

• Own systems end to end: design, build, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, measure, and iterate in production

• Solve for freshness, incremental indexing, deduplication, crawl scheduling, and large-scale corpus management

• Work directly with the Head of Search and the team to shape the roadmap and ship customer-facing improvements quickly

What You Bring

• 3+ years building and operating production search or retrieval systems, with direct ownership of ranking and relevance

• A specific example of a ranking or reranking change you owned and the measurable impact it had on relevance, recall, conversion, CTR, NDCG, MRR, or a similar metric

• Hands-on information-retrieval depth across BM25/lexical, semantic/vector, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and retrieval or RAG evaluation

• Strong backend and distributed-systems skills in Go, Rust, Python, or a comparable language, with end-to-end production ownership

• Experience improving latency and cost at meaningful query volume while maintaining quality and reliability

• Familiarity with search and infrastructure tooling such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Redis, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP, gRPC, or Protobuf

Key Success Drivers
The people who do well here have personally owned search quality in production, think end-to-end about relevance, crawling, indexing, serving, latency, and cost, and thrive in ambiguity by shipping, measuring, and iterating quickly without needing a fully defined playbook.
Why Join?

• Compensation & Equity: Base salary of $235K-$260K+. Meaningful equity in a fast-growing, well-funded startup

• Traction: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled in year two. 125,000+ GitH

The Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that benefit Americans nationwide. As a national nonprofit law firm, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California; Arlington, Virginia; and Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. PLF has an unmatched record in the U.S. Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 cases heard by the Court. PLF also has nearly 200 active cases across the nation. Since 2024, PLF’s state-policy team has capitalized on our Supreme Court wins and helped pass 96 bills across 41 states by testifying, refining bill language, and guiding local allies toward victory. At PLF, we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.
 
As a member of the State Policy team, you will work with all PLF’s capabilities-litigation, strategic research, coalitions, and communications-to draft legislation, model bills, one-pagers, research memos, and blogs and op-eds supporting our mission and vision.
 
Your specific job duties will likely include:
Conducting legislative and other research to support policy drafting

This role is ideal for someone with:
Curiosity about the law and public policy
Knowledge of and a principled passion for individual liberty, one that transcends private or other political interests
Strong writing and research skills

If you think you might be a good fit, submit in ONE PDF:
A résumé that includes relevant experience in the liberty movement and professional skills.
A cover letter explaining why PLF is the place for you, why you want to fight for liberty, and what distinguishes you from typical applicants.

We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate team member based in Australia to join our Asia-Pacific Real-Time Coverage (RTC) team! As a Lead Analyst, you will be the human in the loop to support our AI-first approach to alerts by gathering, corroborating and curating social media chatter.
Who we are
samdesk is a real-time risk detection and situational awareness platform that delivers real time crisis alerts 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, powered by AI. We make sense of the world’s most valuable real time data sources with the purpose of creating a safer world. samdesk is proudly headquartered in Alberta, Canada, with team members located all over the world.
Please note that this is a fully remote, full-time Lead Analyst position. There is a requirement for regular weekend and public holiday shifts, typically between 9am - 5pm AEST. Specific roster requirements will be discussed with the successful candidate.
Check us out! www. samdesk .io
About the role
Reporting to the Regional Manager, Asia-Pacific, this is a demanding yet rewarding role providing critical live coverage of events occurring across the globe as part of our worldwide RTC team. The Lead Analyst will mentor and support other analysts while helping shape the direction of the Asia-Pacific team.
The samdesk platform is an AI tool that is not only the first to break the news but also provides the information and context needed by today's Fortune 500 organizations in their growing business continuity needs. The alert you send to a customer about an active shooter threat at a shopping mall may prompt them to advise nearby customers and employees to seek shelter, lockdown stores and reroute deliveries away from the area. As such, customers trust us to provide them with up-to-date and accurate information on time. It can be high pressure but we provide a friendly, supportive team alongside the tools and training you need to succeed.
samdesk alerts vary greatly and range from disruptive weather and conflict updates to bomb threats and shootings. During a shift, you may have hundreds of incidents to evaluate and make a decision on. You may only have 10 seconds to make a decision on each incident - do our customers need to react to this?

• You value accountability, both personal and collective, and ensure your team delivers on commitments with consistency and integrity

• You are interested in breaking news and current affairs and understand the value of social media newsgathering and fact-finding

• You have an interest in geopolitical issues and how they may impact businesses, people and governments

title: Logistics & Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
NeoWork is hiring Logistics & Supply Chain Coordinators to keep orders, shipments, and inventory moving for U.S. companies. You will coordinate with carriers, warehouses, and customers to make sure every order arrives on time.

NeoWork is a global staffing and operations partner that builds dedicated remote teams for fast-growing U.S. companies. Our teammates work directly inside our clients' teams and tools, while NeoWork takes care of recruiting, HR, benefits, and ongoing support.
Key Responsibilities

• Manage purchase orders, order entry, and order status updates
• Coordinate shipments with carriers, 3PL warehouses, and internal teams
• Track deliveries and proactively resolve delays or exceptions
• Reconcile inventory between systems and investigate discrepancies
• Communicate order and delivery updates to customers and stakeholders
• Maintain accurate records across portals and systems

Requirements

• 1-2+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, or order management
• Strong attention to detail with high-volume, multi-system work

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
• Good written and spoken English

• Strong organizational and follow-up skills
• Availability to work U.S. business hours
• Based in Colombia, with a reliable home office setup and stable internet connection

Nice to Have
• Experience with NetSuite, an ERP, or a TMS
• Experience working with U.S. carriers and 3PLs

• Fluency in Spanish
Benefits

• We offer health insurance for contractors

• Holiday Extra Pay

• The work hours generally align with standard business hours in the US, with some potential flexibility depending on the client's needs.
• This is a 100% home-based position
• We prioritize the mental health of our team members and offer mental health days to support their well-being.
• In addition to the base salary, performance-based incentives are provided.
• There is an annual review and appraisal process in place.
• There are ample opportunities for professional growth and advancement within the company.

title: Distinguished Engineer, AI Security Systems
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Lab:
AI is changing cyber offense and defense simultaneously. Adversaries use models to inspect code, hunt vulnerabilities, adapt tooling, and conduct longer operations. CrowdStrike built the Cybersecurity Superintelligence Lab to ensure defenders stay ahead.

The Lab is CrowdStrike’s frontier AI research organization for cyber defense. Its work spans frontier and open-weight models, CrowdStrike-trained models, specialized agents, reinforcement learning, evaluation, and secure deployment.

The Lab combines trillions of Falcon events each day, more than a decade of adversary intelligence, expert-validated outcomes, and high-fidelity environments where offensive and defensive AI can attack, defend, learn, and prove what works in real enterprise environments.

About the Role:
We are seeking a Distinguished Engineer who has built AI and security systems that operate in the real world and stop real adversaries.

You may have worked on the endpoint, where every millisecond, megabyte, and CPU cycle matters, or at cloud scale, where systems reason over trillions of events and design decisions affect cost, latency, and efficacy across millions of protected assets. Ideally, you understand both.

As one of the Lab’s most senior technical leaders, you will architect systems that turn frontier AI into autonomous, trustworthy cyber defense-from the sensor to the cloud. You will write code, design experiments, set technical direction across research and engineering teams, and carry breakthroughs into the Falcon platform.

If you have shipped AI that stops adversaries in production and want to build what comes next, we want to talk.

What You’ll Do:

• Architect the Lab’s AI security systems end to end, including models, agents, security telemetry, tools, execution environments, on-sensor inference, and cloud-scale reasoning.

• Bring frontier AI to the endpoint using distillation, quantization, compact and specialized models, and integration with kernel- and user-mode telemetry.
